candidates.search_text: site:climate.ec.europa.eu F-gas portal reporting labelling certification new rules 2024
candidates.source_title: F-gases: new rules on labelling, reporting, certification and the F-gas Portal
candidates.proposition: A new annual-report format entered the F-gas Portal for reports due 31 March 2025, alongside label and registration-control changes.
candidates.contradiction: The source establishes duties, not third-party demand, payer counts, case frequency, or deficient incumbent tools.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: show five importers a fixed-price reconciliation pack and ask for one prepaid report-year case.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Economic operators face annual reporting, label, and portal tasks; regulatory, finance, packaging, or trade teams are plausible payers, but no denominator is reported.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Sell one reconciliation draft, product-family label pack, or portal-remediation pack; the operator retains attestation and submission rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: Seek referrals from customs brokers, environmental advisers, packaging bureaus, and freight forwarders at deadline or rejection events.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Reachable entities, event frequency, € price, incumbent coverage, ERP access, portal authorization, security, and simplification effects remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu EU Payment Observatory late payments SMEs collection burden 2025
candidates.proposition: More than half of EU companies reported late-payment difficulties in 2024, and collection imposes significant administrative burden.
candidates.contradiction: Country and sector performance varies; the source does not attribute delay to documentation defects or establish Polish willingness to pay.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: offer ten Polish SME finance owners one prepaid manual invoice-exception case with explicit terms.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Late payment strains cash flow and administration; construction and healthcare SMEs are exposed, but the Polish payer denominator is absent.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge per corrected claim, accepted buyer report, or licensed-partner funding close; creditors retain collection rights and funders retain credit authority.
dossier.acquisition_route: Start through accountants, bookkeepers, export advisers, and licensed finance partners serving firms with live overdue invoices.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Delay causes, recoverable values, € fee tolerance, fraud controls, licensing boundaries, partner economics, and repeat rates remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:commission.europa.eu COM 2025 378 industrial heat PPA guarantees grid industrial decarbonisation
candidates.source_title: Delivering on the Clean Industrial Deal I (COM(2025) 378)
candidates.proposition: The Commission described €500 million of PPA counter-guarantee capability and a planned €1 billion industrial-process-heat auction pilot.
candidates.contradiction: Several mechanisms were pilots or consultations, and the document does not show intermediary demand or site-right assignment economics.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: seek one conditional LOI from a named heat user or renewable developer before committing option capital.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Industry needs finance and stable-energy structures, but no count of projects blocked by evidence assembly or origination is supplied.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge for one heat-finance packet, signed PPA term sheet, or assignable site option; counterparties retain approval and land rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: Source factories through equipment partners and banks, and sites through the founder's regional installer and landowner network.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Pipeline, close time, € fees, grid fatality, guarantees, credit, permitting, option assignability, and capital-loss sensitivity remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules new transparency requirements 2 August
candidates.source_title: Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and new transparency requirements on 2 August
candidates.proposition: From 2 August 2026, certain interactive AI must disclose AI interaction, while generated content may require labels and machine-readable marks.
candidates.contradiction: The release does not establish coverage of clinics or campaigns, workflow failure rates, outsourcing demand, or exact duty allocation.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: map one live workflow with ten EU operations leads and request one prepaid release-control pilot.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Platforms, clinics, and agencies may face rework or delay, but the source provides no buyer denominator or budget proxy.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Sell one integration validation, chatbot scan, or campaign clearance pack; providers and deployers retain classification and release authority.
dossier.acquisition_route: Use imminent-release outreach and referrals from asset-management integrators, medical-software implementers, and production studios.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Scope, exemptions, liable party, € price, procurement, existing-tool adequacy, metadata durability, and counsel cost remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:commission.europa.eu pay transparency explained 5 June 2026 employer reporting worker information rights
candidates.source_title: New EU rules on pay transparency explained
candidates.proposition: Employers must provide salary ranges and requested comparator pay information; employers with at least 100 workers must report pay gaps.
candidates.contradiction: The page does not specify Polish implementation details, intermediary demand, data-processing design, or current HR-tool gaps.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: ask five Polish payroll or employment-law partners to sponsor one prepaid live mapping case.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Employers need reproducible ranges, worker categories, and responses; HR, compensation, and legal budgets are plausible but unquantified.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge per payroll mapping, ATS range-control setup, or employee-response packet; the employer retains classification and disclosure rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: White-label through payroll bureaus, employment counsel, ATS consultants, recruiters, and privacy advisers with live cases.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Polish duties, thresholds, request volume, lawful access, heterogeneous data cost, € pricing, and incumbent absorption remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu CRA reporting manufacturer vulnerabilities incidents deadlines 2026
candidates.proposition: From 11 September 2026, manufacturers must report qualifying vulnerabilities and incidents, with 24-hour and 72-hour deadlines via the Single Reporting Platform.
candidates.contradiction: These manufacturer reporting duties do not prove importer, installer, or hospital demand for adjacent evidence-review services.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: apply a mock evidence-gap review to live SKUs or tenders and request one prepaid bounded engagement.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Connected-product evidence can affect market access and procurement, but buyer counts, questionnaire frequency, and budgets are not reported.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge per-SKU gap review, reusable buyer passport, or hospital tender review; manufacturers retain filings and buyers retain acceptance rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: Use testing labs, customs advisers, wholesalers, tender advisers, and hospital-cyber specialists at blocked-sale events.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Product scope, medical overlap, accepted evidence, supplier access, € price, confidential handling, liability, and repeat volume remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:climate.ec.europa.eu F-gas technician certification alternatives refrigerants six certificates member states one year
candidates.source_title: F-gases: new rules on labelling, reporting, certification and the F-gas Portal
candidates.proposition: Technician certification expanded to alternative refrigerants across six certificate types, with Member States given one year to adapt programmes.
candidates.contradiction: The source gives no evidence of misdispatch frequency, employer willingness to pay, or inadequate verification and training incumbents.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: ask ten Polish contractors for one prepaid roster cleanup tied to a tender or season.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Contractors may lose dispatches when credential scope mismatches equipment; employer service or training budgets are plausible but unmeasured.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge per verified technician roster or cohort diagnostic; issuers retain certification rights and employers retain dispatch authority.
dossier.acquisition_route: Pilot through a regional installer, then seek wholesaler, association, vocational-school, and recognized-certifier referrals.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Polish pathways, registry access, job-scope rules, misdispatch rate, € price, seasonality, and partner distribution remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu EU Data Act users control data connected devices repair maintenance agriculture access sharing rights
candidates.source_title: EU Data Act gives users control over data from connected devices
candidates.proposition: Connected-device users can access, use, and share raw device data, including industrial performance data, and choose third-party repair providers.
candidates.contradiction: Legal access does not establish standardized interfaces, complete histories, usable signals, counterparty acceptance, or purchasing demand.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: with consenting owners, manually export three brands and attempt one decision-grade report before connectors.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Owners may seek independent maintenance or performance analysis, but no asset denominator, budget, or savings evidence is given.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge for a maintenance decision, farm benchmark, commissioning certificate, or warranty case; owners authorize access and counterparties retain liability rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: Start with one machine family through a service partner or one heat-pump brand through the family installer.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Export completeness, signal quality, cross-brand cost, € willingness, privacy, trade secrets, attribution, and remedy acceptance remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:commission.europa.eu COM 2025 378 steel aluminium scrap monitoring recycled products sustainability requirements
candidates.source_title: Delivering on the Clean Industrial Deal I (COM(2025) 378)
candidates.proposition: EU scrap use was declining, while the Commission opened customs-surveillance data and planned monitoring and measures to increase recycled-product demand.
candidates.contradiction: The communication does not prove lot rejection, tender-document pain, assay economics, or need for an intermediary; measures were evolving.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: seek one conditional paid mandate tied to an actual scrap lot or metal-fabrication tender.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Scrap sellers or fabricators may lose price or tenders from untrusted evidence, but transaction frequency and budgets are absent.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Take a disclosed fee on buyer-accepted assayed lots or accepted tender packets; laboratories and issuers retain evidence rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: Start with one assay partner and foundry catchment, or one exporter tender via metal distributors and advisers.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: € price impact, regional density, sampling, waste rules, assay capital, buyer acceptance, document access, and repeat demand remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:uokik.gov.pl pompy ciepła wspólne działania UOKiK IH KAS dokumentacja oznakowanie modele spoza UE
candidates.source_title: Pompy ciepła – wspólne działania UOKiK, IH i KAS
candidates.proposition: Polish authorities found formal defects in 32 of 34 inspected non-EU heat-pump models and stopped 786 units at the border.
candidates.contradiction: The inspection was formal; it does not establish unsafe performance, persistent defects after remediation, or buyer willingness to pay.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: verify documents on twenty live quotes through two installers and request one prepaid readiness case.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Importers and buyers face blocked models or weak purchase evidence, but inspection prevalence is not a commercial payer denominator.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge per quote or shipment-readiness review; importers retain market-placement rights and buyers retain purchase decisions.
dossier.acquisition_route: Use the family installer for live quotes, plus customs brokers, laboratories, wholesalers, and financing partners for referrals.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: € willingness, remediation recurrence, registry completeness, technical-test cost, warranty recognition, measurement attribution, and service liability remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:nik.gov.pl gminy nie są gotowe starzenie społeczeństwa luki opieka seniorami 19 gmin ewidencja monitoring
candidates.source_title: Gminy nie są gotowe na starzenie się społeczeństwa. NIK wskazuje luki w opiece nad seniorami
candidates.proposition: NIK found imprecise service documentation and limited formal quality monitoring; care spending and national programmes provide budget proxies.
candidates.contradiction: Only 19 municipalities were audited, while funding and staffing—not software—may be the binding constraint.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: request two paid eight-week municipal pilots with predefined documentation and administrative-hour outcomes.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: Municipalities must organize care and already spend public funds, but procurement urgency and addressable budgets are unknown.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Sell delivery-proof or consented-referral pilots; municipalities retain service authority and residents retain applicable consent rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: Reach directors through municipal associations, public-sector resellers, or one anchor municipality and permissioned local partners.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Legal basis, procurement, € budget, worker usability, privacy, referral capacity, staffing, and whether records improve outcomes remain unknown.

candidates.search_text: site:digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu AI Act complaints channel downstream providers transparency evidence 2 August 2026
candidates.source_title: Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and new transparency requirements on 2 August
candidates.proposition: AI Act enforcement began 2 August 2026, with official complaint tools including a channel for downstream general-purpose-AI providers.
candidates.contradiction: The release does not prove complaint-reconstruction failures, stalled procurements, lawful retention needs, or neutral-intermediary demand.
candidates.cheapest_resolving_test: Future test: map five complaint and five procurement workflows, then request one paid setup tied to a live case.

dossier.problem_and_payer_evidence: AI vendors may need reconstructable evidence or duty allocation, but event frequency, failure cost, and budgets are unreported.
dossier.proposed_transaction: Charge per complaint-channel setup or active procurement workspace; contracting parties retain legal approval and evidence rights.
dossier.acquisition_route: Use observability partners for post-complaint cases and governance or vendor-review consultants for stalled procurements.
dossier.decision_critical_unknowns: Minimum lawful evidence, retention, security cost, € willingness, urgency, two-sided conflicts, and incumbent-tool adequacy remain unknown.
